summary: Preserve driver activity with no blocking condition and batch population source evidence reads

replay.detail: Existing observations are folded without replay or backfill.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or claim changes.

rules.detail: Runtime ownership, work assignment and attention lifecycle rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Population classification treats the driver none and unknown blocking sentinels as non-positive wait evidence, preserving observed working and idle activity. Only positive blocking evidence selects waiting. Workspace observation projection and attention ownership reads are batched over selected subjects, preserving canonical source ownership while avoiding per-item client-read and refresher queries.

manual.detail: No new configuration or operator action; the original population rollout prerequisites remain in force.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; durable state is unchanged.
